decision.reason: At finite index the index is nonzero in C. Apply the two checked index-valued curl identities and cancel the scalar against its inverse.
decision.proof:
by
  intro U inst K H G δ α hδ hα d a S finite inverseIndex
  let _ : Subgroup.FiniteIndex S := finite
  have hn : (S.index : Complex) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Subgroup.index_ne_zero_of_finite
  have hscale {A B : Type u} [Group A] [Group B] {X Y : MackeyDiagrams.Biset A B}
      (f : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex X Y) :
      (f.scale (S.index : Complex)).scale inverseIndex = f := by
    apply MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    change (S.index : Complex)⁻¹ • ((S.index : Complex) • f.toLinearMap x) = _
    rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn, one_smul]
  constructor
  · intro up loopUp loopDown straight cup middle cap curl
    have hc : curl.eval = (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale (S.index : Complex) straight).eval :=
      RightUpReidemeisterCurl K H G δ α hδ hα finite
    change curl.eval.scale inverseIndex = _
    rw [hc]
    exact hscale straight.eval
  · intro down loopUp loopDown straight cup middle cap curl
    have hc : curl.eval = (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale (S.index : Complex) straight).eval :=
      LeftDownReidemeisterCurl K H G δ α hδ hα finite
    change curl.eval.scale inverseIndex = _
    rw [hc]
    exact hscale straight.eval
